collection.title: VW Passat CC 2011 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a VW Passat CC 2011 Onwards  model which requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 19" for the passengers side. This model uses the Slim Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.

image.alt: VW Passat CC 2011 to 2024 Windscreen Wiper Blades
